name: SCRUM-8 AC4-AC5 - Valid OrangeHRM login redirects to Dashboard
objective: Verify that valid OrangeHRM demo credentials authenticate the user and that the Dashboard page is displayed.
precondition: OrangeHRM demo is available and ORANGEHRM_USERNAME and ORANGEHRM_PASSWORD are configured for the test environment.

steps.description: Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page.
steps.testData: OrangeHRM demo URL configured as BASE_URL.
steps.expectedResult: The OrangeHRM login form is displayed.

steps.description: Enter valid credentials from the configured test environment and submit the login form.
steps.expectedResult: Authentication succeeds and the application navigates to the Dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the resulting URL and ensure the login route is no longer active.
steps.expectedResult: The URL contains /dashboard and does not contain /auth/login.
